title: Patient notice before pharmacy closure
rule_summary: A closing pharmacy identifies patients served in the preceding 90 days, attempts notice at least 14 days before closure, posts conspicuous notice, and supports timely patient-file transfer.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply closure patient notice requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing closure patient notice with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
